messages:
Renee (CS Ops): quick heads-up  seeing an increase in health oscillations for the SMB onboarding cohort (accounts <30d). used to be a light weekly wobble, now amplitude is higher and some accounts flip to 'at-risk' briefly.
Diego (Data): curious if it's an ingest or scoring mismatch. can you drop a sample query?
Renee (CS Ops): sure  small one: 
```sql
select account_id, created_at, health_v3, last_seen_ts, source
from account_metrics
where created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
and health_v3 between 25 and 45
order by created_at desc
limit 100;
```
Omar (CRM): sounds like the recent contact-merge job might be backfilling older last_seen_ts on duplicates. i saw a related change last week.
Lina (Enablement): noisy at-risk flags cause CS to over-index. i'd prefer a short smoothing fallback: either a 7-day moving avg for accounts <30d or a 48h "hold before escalate" window. lightweight and reversible.
Renee (CS Ops): agree. proposal: sample 10% of affected accounts, apply smoothing (moving_avg=7d) for that sample, pause auto-escalations and renewal nudges for 5 days, tag with "smoothing:temp". let CS manually review any obvious misses.
playbook-bot: created run id smoothing-707070  status: queued. (/playbooks/run smoothing-707070) :gear:
Diego (Data): running sampling now. i'll stratify by cohort and MRR band. will upload CSV to /shared/cs/smoothing-707070.csv when done.
Diego (Data): sampling done  100 accounts sampled, breakdown: 82% show last_seen overwritten by merge job within last 48h, 18% true low activity. uploading CSV.
Omar (CRM): i'll add a guard to the merge pipeline: only apply contact merge if incoming_last_seen >= existing_last_seen. pushing a patch (flagged) to staging. snippet: 
```py
if incoming.last_seen_ts >= existing.last_seen_ts:
    apply_merge()
else:
    skip_merge()
```
Renee (CS Ops): perfect. playbook actions for smoothing-707070: 
```yaml
run_id: smoothing-707070
sample_rate: 0.10
actions:
  - apply_moving_avg: 7d
  - pause_auto_escalations: true
  - suppress_renewal_nudges: 5d
  - add_tags: [smoothing:temp, cs:manual-review]
  - notify: cs-leads@redwood.com
```
Lina (Enablement): can we expose a run toggle in admin so CS leads can lift the hold per cohort? want to avoid involving ops for flips.
Omar (CRM): added admin flag path admin.playbooks.smoothing_run=smoothing-707070. will keep flag for 48h after sampling.
playbook-bot: smoothing-707070 moved to in-progress  safeguard enacted for sampled cohort. :white_check_mark:
Renee (CS Ops): next steps: Diego posts full breakdown and cohort CSV, Omar verifies staging patch smoke, Lina drafts a one-line owner note for any accounts we surface as false-negative, and i'll run the sampled triage tomorrow 9am PT. tagging @channel for visibility.
Diego (Data): uploading CSV now and adding a quick dashboard tile for "merge_backfill_rate" to alert if >3% in 24h.
Renee (CS Ops): thanks all  will update once triage completes.
